description: This file contains the code-behind for the TakenCourses page in an online examination system. It includes event handlers for navigation buttons such as Home, Profile, Leaderboard, and Logout, all of which transfer the user to different pages within the application.

classes.name: TakenCourses
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TakenCourses web page, handling page load and button click events for navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load events; currently contains no logic.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'Home' button; transfers user to Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'Profile' button; transfers user to User Profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'Leaderboard' button; transfers user to Leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'Logout' button; transfers user to Login page.
